segments.text: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?

footnotes.text: + thy…: or, thy valley floweth away

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon,
saith the LORD.
¶ Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts;

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

footnotes.text: + turn…: or, they are turned back

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
For thus saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof,
saith the LORD,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

footnotes.text: + appoint me…: or, convent me in judgment?

segments.text: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
¶ Concerning Damascus.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

footnotes.text: + on…: or, as on the sea

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
¶ Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: ¶ Flee, get you far off,
dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care,
saith the LORD,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

footnotes.text: + wealthy: or, that is at ease

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof,
saith the LORD.

footnotes.text: + in…: Heb. cut off into corners, or, that have the corners of their hair polled

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
¶ The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
Thus saith the LORD of hosts;

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life:
and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: ¶ But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam,
saith the LORD.
